        puddle.Anchored = true
        puddle.CanCollide = false
        puddle.Parent = workspace

                puddle.Transparency = 0.25 + (i * 0.05)
                task.wait(0.3)
            end
            if puddle.Parent then

            end
        end)

            TweenService:Create(

                TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),

            ):Play()

            TweenService:Create(

        local hue = math.random() * 360

        local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChild("WeatherColor")
        if cc then

            task.delay(0.3, function()

                    TweenService:Create(

                        TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),

    local function stopWeather()
        if not WeatherOn then return end
        WeatherOn = false

        for _, conn in ipairs(WeatherConnections) do
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
        WeatherConnections = {}

        for _, thread in ipairs(WeatherThreads) do
            task.cancel(thread)
        end
        WeatherThreads = {}

        for _, part in ipairs(WeatherObjects.parts or {}) do
            if part.Parent then
                local tween = TweenService:Create(
                    part,
                    TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                    {Size = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)}
                )
                tween:Play()
                Debris:AddItem(part, 2)
            end
        end

        if WeatherObjects.sound and WeatherObjects.sound.Parent then
            local tween = TweenService:Create(
                WeatherObjects.sound,
                TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                {Volume = 0}
            )
            tween:Play()
            Debris:AddItem(WeatherObjects.sound, 2)
        end

        for _, name in ipairs({"WeatherBlur", "WeatherColor", "WeatherBloom"}) do
            local fx = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
            if fx then
                local target = {Size = 0}
                if fx:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
                    target = {Contrast = 0, Saturation = 0}
                elseif fx:IsA("BloomEffect") then
                    target = {Intensity = 0}
                end
                local tween = TweenService:Create(
                    fx,
                    TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                    target
                )
                tween:Play()
                Debris:AddItem(fx, 2)
            end
        end

        if WeatherObjects.originalLighting then
            TweenService:Create(
                Lighting,
                TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
                WeatherObjects.originalLighting
            ):Play()
        end

        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj.Name == "WeatherPuddle" then
                local tween = TweenService:Create(
                    obj,
                    TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                    {Transparency = 1}
                )
                tween:Play()
                Debris:AddItem(obj, 1.5)
            end
        end

        WeatherObjects = {}
    end

            stopWeather()
            task.wait(0.3)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

		AnchorParts = { "Root" },
		StateAttribute = "State",
		ChaseStates = { chase = true, hunt = true, kill = true },
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 200),
	},
	{
		Name = "SCROW",
		Path = { "Scrow" },
		AnchorParts = { "Root" },
		StateAttribute = "State",
		ChaseStates = { chase = true, hunt = true },
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 120, 255),
	},
}

local monitorDistance = 60
local minActiveHeight = -50
local maxDrawDistance = 3000
local keyColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
local keyLabelColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 90)
local arrowGlyph = "\226\158\156"

local keyModels = {}
local monsterModels = {}
local connections = {}
local espOn = true
local unloaded = false

local function walkPath(root, path)
	local node = root
	for _, segment in ipairs(path) do
		if node == nil then
			return nil
		end
		node = node:FindFirstChild(segment)
	end
	return node
end

local function getKeyPosition(model)
	local point = model:FindFirstChild("KeyPoint", true)
	if point and point:IsA("Attachment") then
		return point.WorldPosition
	end

	local mesh = model:FindFirstChild("KEY__key")
	if mesh and mesh:IsA("BasePart") then
		return mesh.Position
	end

	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			return d.Position
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function getMonsterPosition(model, anchorParts)
	for _, partName in ipairs(anchorParts) do
		local part = model:FindFirstChild(partName, true)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			return part.Position
		end
	end

	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 1 then
			return d.Position
		end
	end

	local root = model:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return root.Position
	end

	return nil
end

local function distanceFromPlayer(position)
	if position == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		return (root.Position - position).Magnitude
	end

	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		return (camera.CFrame.Position - position).Magnitude
	end

	return nil
end

local function readState(model, spec)
	if not spec.StateAttribute then
		return nil
	end

	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return model:GetAttribute(spec.StateAttribute)
	end)

	if ok and value ~= nil then
		return tostring(value)
	end

	return nil
end

local function isChasingState(state, spec)
	if not state then
		return false
	end

	local upper = string.upper(state)
	for chaseState in pairs(spec.ChaseStates) do
		if upper == string.upper(chaseState) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

	arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	arrow.Text = arrowGlyph
	arrow.Visible = false
	arrow.Parent = playerGui
	return arrow
end

local function updateArrow(arrow, position, color)
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	if viewport.X <= 0 or viewport.Y <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local screenPoint, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)

	if onScreen and screenPoint.Z > 0 then
		local clampedX = math.clamp(screenPoint.X, 48, viewport.X - 48)
		local clampedY = math.clamp(screenPoint.Y, 48, viewport.Y - 48)

		if clampedX == screenPoint.X and clampedY == screenPoint.Y then
			arrow.Visible = false
			return
		end

		arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(clampedX, clampedY)
	else
		local relative = camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		local flat = Vector2.new(relative.X, relative.Y)

		if flat.Magnitude < 1e-4 then
			flat = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		else
			flat = flat.Unit
		end

		if relative.Z > 0 then
			flat = -flat
		end

		local halfX = viewport.X / 2
		local halfY = viewport.Y / 2
		local scale = math.min(
			halfX / math.max(math.abs(flat.X), 1e-4),
			halfY / math.max(math.abs(flat.Y), 1e-4)
		)

		local projectedX = halfX + flat.X * scale
		local projectedY = halfY - flat.Y * scale

		arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
			math.clamp(projectedX, 48, viewport.X - 48),
			math.clamp(projectedY, 48, viewport.Y - 48)
		)
	end

	arrow.TextColor3 = color
	arrow.Visible = true
end

local function destroyEntry(entry)
	for _, inst in ipairs({ entry.Highlight, entry.Gui, entry.Arrow }) do
		if inst then
			inst:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function collectKeys()
	local found = {}

	for _, source in ipairs(keySources) do
		local container = walkPath(Workspace, source)
		if container then
			for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				local key = child:FindFirstChild("Key")
				if key and key:IsA("Model") then
					table.insert(found, key)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return found
end

local function collectMonsters()
	local found = {}

	for _, spec in ipairs(monsterList) do
		local model = walkPath(Workspace, spec.Path)
		if model and model.Parent then
			local position = getMonsterPosition(model, spec.AnchorParts)
			if position and position.Y > minActiveHeight then
				table.insert(found, { Model = model, Spec = spec })
			end
		end
	end

	return found
end

local function syncEsp()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	local liveKeys = {}
	for _, model in ipairs(collectKeys()) do
		liveKeys[model] = true
		if not keyModels[model] then
			local ok, entry = pcall(buildKeyEsp, model)
			if ok and entry then
				keyModels[model] = entry
			end
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		if not liveKeys[model] or not model.Parent then
			destroyEntry(entry)
			keyModels[model] = nil
		end
	end

	local liveMonsters = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(collectMonsters()) do
		liveMonsters[item.Model] = item.Spec
		if not monsterModels[item.Model] then
			local ok, entry = pcall(buildMonsterEsp, item.Model, item.Spec)
			if ok and entry then
				monsterModels[item.Model] = entry
			end
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		if not liveMonsters[model] or not model.Parent then
			destroyEntry(entry)
			monsterModels[model] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function updateKeyEsp(entry)
	local position = getKeyPosition(entry.Model)
	if position == nil then
		return
	end

	local distance = distanceFromPlayer(position)
	if distance then
		entry.Label.Text = "KEY  " .. tostring(math.floor(distance + 0.5)) .. "m"
	end

	if entry.Arrow then
		updateArrow(entry.Arrow, position, keyColor)
	end
end

local function updateMonsterEsp(entry)
	local position = getMonsterPosition(entry.Model, entry.Spec.AnchorParts)
	if position == nil then
		return
	end

	local distance = distanceFromPlayer(position)
	local state = readState(entry.Model, entry.Spec)
	local chasing = isChasingState(state, entry.Spec)
	local close = distance ~= nil and distance <= monitorDistance

	local color = entry.Spec.Color
	if close then
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	elseif chasing then
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0)
	end

	entry.Highlight.OutlineColor = color
	entry.Highlight.FillColor = color
	entry.Highlight.FillTransparency = close and 0.7 or 0.85
	entry.Title.TextColor3 = color
	entry.Title.Text = close and (entry.Spec.Name .. "  !!") or entry.Spec.Name

	local info = {}
	if state then
		table.insert(info, string.upper(state))
	end
	if distance then
		table.insert(info, tostring(math.floor(distance + 0.5)) .. "m")
	end
	if close then
		table.insert(info, "CLOSE")
	end
	entry.Subtitle.Text = table.concat(info, "  ")

	if entry.Arrow then
		updateArrow(entry.Arrow, position, color)
	end
end

local function setEspVisible(visible)
	espOn = visible

	for _, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		entry.Highlight.Enabled = visible
		entry.Gui.Enabled = visible
		if not visible and entry.Arrow then
			entry.Arrow.Visible = false
		end
	end

	for _, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		entry.Highlight.Enabled = visible
		entry.Gui.Enabled = visible
		if not visible and entry.Arrow then
			entry.Arrow.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

local function unloadEsp()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	unloaded = true
	espOn = false

	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		destroyEntry(entry)
		keyModels[model] = nil
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		destroyEntry(entry)
		monsterModels[model] = nil
	end
end

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
	task.defer(syncEsp)
end))

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function()
	task.defer(syncEsp)
end))

table.insert(connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		if model.Parent then
			pcall(updateKeyEsp, entry)
		else
			destroyEntry(entry)
			keyModels[model] = nil
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		if model.Parent then
			pcall(updateMonsterEsp, entry)
		else
			destroyEntry(entry)
			monsterModels[model] = nil
		end
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed or unloaded then
		return
	end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
		setEspVisible(not espOn)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
		unloadEsp()
	end
end))

task.spawn(function()
	while not unloaded do
		task.wait(0.75)
		pcall(syncEsp)
	end
end)

syncEsp()

local function makeDraggable(guiObject)
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

    guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = guiObject.Position
            
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    guiObject.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            guiObject.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, 
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
                startPos.Y.Scale, 
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)
end

local function createKey(name, text, keyCode, sizeX, sizeY, posX, posY)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, sizeX, 0, sizeY)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, posX, 0, posY)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.TextSize = 11
    btn.ZIndex = 100
    btn.Active = true
    btn.Parent = KeyboardFrame
    
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    corner.Parent = btn
    
    if keyCode then
        btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 100)
        end)
        
        btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
        end)
        
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
            end)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
        end)
    end
    return btn
end

    activeInput = nil
    StickKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0.5, -20)
    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.W, false, game)

--// Cookie Hub v2
--// Categories: Auto Farm (Cookies, Roll, Rebirth) | Upgrades (Roll Speed, Luck)
--// Draggable window + draggable 🍪 button. RightShift also shows/hides the GUI.

local function tween(obj, time, props, style, direction)
	local t = TweenService:Create(
		obj,
		TweenInfo.new(time, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		props
	)
	t:Play()
	return t
end

-- Drag `target` by holding `handle` (mouse + touch). A tap without moving calls `onClick`.
local function makeDraggable(handle, target, onClick)
	local dragging = false
	local moved = false
	local dragStart, startPos

	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			moved = false
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = target.Position

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
					if onClick and not moved then
						onClick()
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			if delta.Magnitude > 5 then
				moved = true
			end
			target.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)
end

local function selectCategory(name)
	for n, page in pairs(pages) do
		page.Visible = (n == name)

	for n, tab in pairs(tabs) do
		local active = (n == name)
		tween(tab, 0.15, {

			TextColor3 = active and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Theme.SubText,

	end

local function createCategory(name, icon, order)
	local tab = Instance.new("TextButton")

local function createCard(parent, feature, order)
	feature.Enabled = false

	local card = Instance.new("Frame")

	switch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)

	knob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
	knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

		tween(switch, 0.18, { BackgroundColor3 = value and feature.Color or Theme.Off })
		tween(knob, 0.18, {
			Position = value and UDim2.fromOffset(25, 3) or UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3),
		}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		tween(cardStroke, 0.18, { Transparency = value and 0.35 or 1 })
		refreshStatus()
	end

	-- the whole card is clickable
	local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	hit.Text = ""
	hit.AutoButtonColor = false
	hit.ZIndex = 5

	end)
	hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		tween(card, 0.12, { BackgroundColor3 = Theme.CardHover })
	end)
	hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		tween(card, 0.12, { BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card })
	end)

	return card
end

--// BUILD CATEGORIES + CARDS + LOOPS
for catIndex, category in ipairs(Categories) do
	local page = createCategory(category.Name, category.Icon, catIndex)

	for featureIndex, feature in ipairs(category.Features) do
		createCard(page, feature, featureIndex)

		-- one loop per feature, runs only while it's switched on
		task.spawn(function()
			while alive do
				if feature.Enabled then
					pcall(feature.Action)
					task.wait(feature.Delay)
				else
					task.wait(0.2)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

local writeOrder=0
local function setProperty(module,object,property,value)
    if not object then return end
    local ok=pcall(function()
        local properties=mutations[object]
        if not properties then properties={}; mutations[object]=properties end
        local record=properties[property]
        if not record then record={original=object[property],layers={}}; properties[property]=record end
        writeOrder+=1
        record.layers[module]={value=value,order=writeOrder}
        object[property]=value
    end)
    return ok
end
local function restoreModule(module)
    for object,properties in pairs(mutations) do
        for property,record in pairs(properties) do
            if record.layers[module] then
                record.layers[module]=nil
                local top
                for _,layer in pairs(record.layers) do if not top or layer.order>top.order then top=layer end end
                pcall(function() if top then object[property]=top.value else object[property]=record.original end end)
                if not top then properties[property]=nil end
            end
        end
        if not next(properties) then mutations[object]=nil end
    end
    if module=="NoFall" then
        for hum,states in pairs(humanoidStates) do
            for state,enabled in pairs(states) do pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(state,enabled) end) end
        end
        table.clear(humanoidStates)

local function applyConfig(values)
    local nextValues=table.clone(configDefaults)
    local function finite(v) return type(v)=="number" and v==v and math.abs(v)<math.huge end
    for k,v in pairs(values) do
        local default=configDefaults[k]
        if default~=nil and k~="AimOn" and k~="Panic" then
            if typeof(default)=="EnumItem" and type(v)=="table" then
                local allowed=(k=="AimKey" and (v.enum=="KeyCode" or v.enum=="UserInputType")) or (k=="PanicKey" and v.enum=="KeyCode")

local function updateGrenadeTrajectory()
	if not S.GrenadeTraj or S.Panic or not running then hideGrenTraj() return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then hideGrenTraj() return end
	local char = LP.Character
	local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if not S.GrenTrajAlways and not isGrenadeTool(tool) then hideGrenTraj() return end

	local origin = cam.CFrame.Position + cam.CFrame.LookVector*2
	local vel = cam.CFrame.LookVector * (S.GrenSpeed or 100) + Vector3.new(0, S.GrenUp or 20, 0)
	local g = Vector3.new(0, -(S.GrenGravity or 196.2), 0)
	local dt = S.GrenTrajTime or 0.05
	local steps = math.clamp(math.floor(S.GrenTrajSteps or 40), 8, 80)
	local points = {origin}
	local pos, v = origin, vel
	local bounces = 0
	local maxB = S.GrenMaxBounces or 2
	local landPos = nil
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ex = {cam}
	if char then table.insert(ex, char) end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ex
	params.IgnoreWater = false

	for i=1,steps do
		local nextV = v + g*dt
		local nextPos = pos + v*dt + g*(0.5*dt*dt)
		local dir = nextPos - pos
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(pos, dir, params)
		if hit then
			table.insert(points, hit.Position)
			landPos = hit.Position
			if S.GrenBounce and bounces < maxB then
				local n = hit.Normal
				v = nextV - 2*nextV:Dot(n)*n
				v = v * 0.55
				pos = hit.Position + n*0.05
				bounces += 1
				landPos = nil -- keep going
			else
				break
			end
		else
			pos = nextPos
			v = nextV
			table.insert(points, pos)
		end
	end
	if not landPos and #points > 0 then landPos = points[#points] end

	local baseThick = math.max(S.GrenThickness or 3, 2)
	local colA = S.GrenColor or Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 140)
	local colB = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
	local drawn = 0
	local nseg = #points - 1

	for i=1,nseg do
		local a,b = points[i], points[i+1]
		local pa, oa = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(a)
		local pb, ob = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(b)
		local line = grenLines[i]
		if line and oa and ob and pa.Z > 0 and pb.Z > 0 then
			local t = nseg > 1 and ((i-1)/(nseg-1)) or 0
			-- gradient: start color -> red toward impact
			local r = colA.R + (colB.R - colA.R) * t
			local gch = colA.G + (colB.G - colA.G) * t
			local bl = colA.B + (colB.B - colA.B) * t
			line.From = Vector2.new(pa.X, pa.Y)
			line.To = Vector2.new(pb.X, pb.Y)
			line.Thickness = baseThick + (1 - t) * 2 -- thicker near start
			line.Color = Color3.new(r, gch, bl)
			line.Transparency = 0.05 + t * 0.15
			line.Visible = true
			drawn = i
		elseif line then
			line.Visible = false
		end
	end
	for i=drawn+1,#grenLines do
		if grenLines[i] then grenLines[i].Visible=false end
	end

	-- dots along path for readability
	local dotCount = 0
	local stepDot = math.max(1, math.floor(#points / 12))
	for i=1,#points,stepDot do
		dotCount += 1
		local c = grenDots[dotCount]
		if not c then break end
		local p, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(points[i])
		if on and p.Z > 0 then
			local t = #points > 1 and ((i-1)/(#points-1)) or 0
			c.Position = Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y)
			c.Radius = 3 + (1-t)*2
			c.Color = Color3.new(
				colA.R + (colB.R-colA.R)*t,
				colA.G + (colB.G-colA.G)*t,
				colA.B + (colB.B-colA.B)*t
			)
			c.Filled = true
			c.Visible = true
			c.Transparency = 0.1
		else
			c.Visible = false
		end
	end
	for i=dotCount+1,#grenDots do
		if grenDots[i] then grenDots[i].Visible=false end
	end

	-- impact marker
	if landPos and grenImpact then
		local ip, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(landPos)
		if on and ip.Z > 0 then
			local pulse = 10 + math.sin(os.clock()*8)*3
			grenImpact.Position = Vector2.new(ip.X, ip.Y)
			grenImpact.Radius = pulse
			grenImpact.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
			grenImpact.Thickness = 3
			grenImpact.Visible = true
			grenImpact.Transparency = 0.05
			local s = 9
			if grenImpactX1 then
				grenImpactX1.From = Vector2.new(ip.X - s, ip.Y - s)
				grenImpactX1.To = Vector2.new(ip.X + s, ip.Y + s)
				grenImpactX1.Visible = true
				grenImpactX1.Thickness = 3
			end
			if grenImpactX2 then
				grenImpactX2.From = Vector2.new(ip.X + s, ip.Y - s)
				grenImpactX2.To = Vector2.new(ip.X - s, ip.Y + s)
				grenImpactX2.Visible = true
				grenImpactX2.Thickness = 3
			end
		else
			grenImpact.Visible = false
			if grenImpactX1 then grenImpactX1.Visible=false end
			if grenImpactX2 then grenImpactX2.Visible=false end
		end
	elseif grenImpact then
		grenImpact.Visible = false
		if grenImpactX1 then grenImpactX1.Visible=false end
		if grenImpactX2 then grenImpactX2.Visible=false end
	end
end

local function solveThrowDirection(fromPos, targetPos, speed, gravity, upBoost)
	-- Ballistic aim: find look direction so projectile with speed+upBoost lands near target
	local g = gravity or 196.2
	local v0 = speed or 100
	local to = targetPos - fromPos
	local distXZ = Vector3.new(to.X, 0, to.Z).Magnitude
	if distXZ < 0.5 then
		return (targetPos - fromPos).Unit
	end
	local y = to.Y
	-- quadratic for angle: use flat speed approximation with extra up
	-- try multiple pitch angles, pick best landing error
	local bestDir, bestErr = nil, math.huge
	local flat = Vector3.new(to.X, 0, to.Z).Unit
	for deg = 5, 70, 0.75 do
		local pitch = math.rad(deg)
		local dir = (flat * math.cos(pitch) + Vector3.yAxis * math.sin(pitch)).Unit
		local vel = dir * v0 + Vector3.new(0, upBoost or 0, 0)
		local pos = fromPos
		local v = vel
		local dt = 0.05
		local err = math.huge
		for _=1,80 do
			v = v + Vector3.new(0, -g, 0) * dt
			local nextPos = pos + v * dt
			-- hit ground-ish near target height band
			if (nextPos - targetPos).Magnitude < err then
				err = (nextPos - targetPos).Magnitude
			end
			-- stop if passed target in XZ and going down
			local xz = Vector3.new(nextPos.X - fromPos.X, 0, nextPos.Z - fromPos.Z).Magnitude
			if xz > distXZ + 5 and v.Y < 0 then break end
			if nextPos.Y < targetPos.Y - 40 and v.Y < 0 then break end
			pos = nextPos
		end
		if err < bestErr then
			bestErr = err
			bestDir = dir
		end
	end
	return bestDir, bestErr
end

local function getNearestEnemyRoot()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return nil end
	local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
	local me = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if me then origin = me.Position end
	local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if alive(p) and p.Character then
			local root = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local d = (root.Position - origin).Magnitude
				if d < bestDist and d <= (S.MaxDist or 2000) then
					bestDist = d
					best = root
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best, bestDist
end

local function updatePerfectThrow(dt)
	if not perfectThrowActive() then return end
	if bindingCapture or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() or pointerOverMenu() then return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end
	-- always prefer nearest enemy for grenade lead
	local target = getNearestEnemyRoot()
	if not target then return end
	local lead = S.PerfectThrowLead or 0.15
	local aimPos = target.Position + Vector3.new(0, S.PerfectThrowHeight or 2, 0)
	local vel = target.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if vel and vel.Magnitude > 0.5 then
		aimPos = aimPos + vel * lead
	end
	local from = cam.CFrame.Position + cam.CFrame.LookVector * 1.5
	local dir = solveThrowDirection(from, aimPos, S.GrenSpeed or 100, S.GrenGravity or 196.2, S.GrenUp or 20)
	if not dir then return end
	local smooth = math.clamp(S.PerfectThrowSmooth or 0.35, 0.05, 1)
	local alpha = 1 - (1 - smooth) ^ (math.clamp(dt or 1/60, 0, 0.1) * 60)
	local want = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.Position + dir)
	cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(want, alpha)
end

-- Grenade auto-calibrate: sample a real thrown projectile and fit gravity/speed
local calibrating = false
local calibConn = nil
local calibSamples = {}
local calibStart = 0

local function setCalibText(t, ok)
	local lab = rawget(_G, "CombatHubCalibLabel")
	if lab then
		lab.Text = t
		lab.TextColor3 = ok==true and T.ok or (ok==false and T.bad or T.dim)
	end
end

local function finishCalibrate(gravity, speed, upBoost)
	calibrating = false
	S.GrenAutoCalibrate = false
	if calibConn then pcall(function() calibConn:Disconnect() end) calibConn=nil end
	if gravity then S.GrenGravity = math.clamp(gravity, 40, 400) end
	if speed then S.GrenSpeed = math.clamp(speed, 30, 250) end
	if upBoost then S.GrenUp = math.clamp(upBoost, 0, 100) end
	-- tune related perfect-throw helpers for current values
	S.GrenTrajSteps = math.clamp(math.floor((S.GrenSpeed or 100) / 2), 24, 64)
	S.PerfectThrowLead = math.clamp((S.GrenSpeed or 100) / 700, 0.08, 0.35)
	for _,fn in ipairs(configRefresh) do pcall(fn) end
	setCalibText(string.format("Calibrated: g=%.1f speed=%.1f up=%.1f (applied to both modules)", S.GrenGravity, S.GrenSpeed, S.GrenUp), true)
	print(string.format("[combat hub] grenade calib g=%.2f speed=%.2f up=%.2f", S.GrenGravity, S.GrenSpeed, S.GrenUp))
end

local function estimateFromSamples(samples)
	if #samples < 4 then return nil end
	-- samples: {t, pos}
	local t0 = samples[1].t
	local p0 = samples[1].pos
	-- initial velocity from early samples
	local early = samples[math.min(3, #samples)]
	local dt1 = early.t - t0
	if dt1 <= 1e-3 then return nil end
	local v0 = (early.pos - p0) / dt1
	local speed = Vector3.new(v0.X, 0, v0.Z).Magnitude
	local up = math.max(0, v0.Y)
	-- gravity from vertical motion: y = y0 + v0y*t - 0.5*g*t^2
	local gSum, gN = 0, 0
	for i=3,#samples do
		local t = samples[i].t - t0
		if t > 0.05 then
			local y = samples[i].pos.Y - p0.Y
			-- y = v0y*t - 0.5*g*t^2  =>  g = 2*(v0y*t - y)/t^2
			local g = 2 * (v0.Y * t - y) / (t * t)
			if g > 20 and g < 500 then
				gSum += g
				gN += 1
			end
		end
	end
	if gN < 1 then return nil end
	return gSum / gN, speed, up
end

function startGrenadeCalibrate()
	if calibrating then
		setCalibText("Already calibrating — throw the grenade now", false)
		return
	end
	calibrating = true
	calibSamples = {}
	calibStart = tick()
	setCalibText("Calibrating… equip grenade and THROW once (4s window)", nil)
	local watched = {}
	if calibConn then pcall(function() calibConn:Disconnect() end) end
	calibConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
		if not calibrating then return end
		if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return end
		local n = obj.Name:lower()
		local look = n:find("grenade",1,true) or n:find("nade",1,true) or n:find("projectile",1,true)
			or n:find("throw",1,true) or n:find("frag",1,true) or n:find("molotov",1,true)
			or n:find("flash",1,true) or n:find("smoke",1,true) or n:find("ball",1,true)
		-- also accept unanchored parts spawned near camera with velocity
		task.defer(function()
			if not calibrating or not obj.Parent then return end
			local ok,vel = pcall(function() return obj.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)
			if not ok or not vel then return end
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not cam then return end
			local near = (obj.Position - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < 25
			local moving = vel.Magnitude > 20
			if (look or (near and moving and not obj.Anchored)) and not watched[obj] then
				watched[obj] = true
				setCalibText("Tracking projectile…", nil)
				local samples = {}
				local start = tick()
				local conn
				conn = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					if not obj.Parent or tick()-start > 2.5 then
						conn:Disconnect()
						local g,sp,up = estimateFromSamples(samples)
						if g then
							finishCalibrate(g, sp, up)
						else
							setCalibText("Track failed — try a longer open throw", false)
							calibrating = false
						end
						return
					end
					local ok2,pos = pcall(function() return obj.Position end)
					if ok2 then table.insert(samples, {t=tick(), pos=pos}) end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end)
	-- timeout
	task.delay(5, function()
		if calibrating then
			calibrating = false
			if calibConn then pcall(function() calibConn:Disconnect() end) calibConn=nil end
			setCalibText("Timed out — press again and throw quickly", false)
		end
	end)
end

local function updateJigglePeek(dt)
	local char = LP.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hum or not hrp then jiggleOrigin=nil return end
	if not jiggleActive() then
		jiggleOrigin = nil
		return
	end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end
	dt = math.clamp(dt or 1/60, 0, 0.1)
	if not jiggleOrigin then
		jiggleOrigin = hrp.Position
		jigglePhase = 0
	end
	jigglePhase = jigglePhase + (S.JiggleSpeed or 12) * dt
	local side = math.sin(jigglePhase * math.pi * 2) -- full left-right cycle
	local right = Vector3.new(cam.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, cam.CFrame.RightVector.Z)
	if right.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return end
	right = right.Unit
	local dist = S.JiggleDist or 2.5
	-- target offset from origin along camera right
	local target = jiggleOrigin + right * (side * dist)
	local to = target - hrp.Position
	local flat = Vector3.new(to.X, 0, to.Z)
	local speed = math.max(hum.WalkSpeed, 18) * 1.35
	if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then
		local dir = flat.Unit
		hum:Move(dir, false)
		local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * speed, v.Y, dir.Z * speed)
	else
		hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
	end
	-- slowly recenter origin so you can walk while jiggling
	jiggleOrigin = jiggleOrigin:Lerp(Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, jiggleOrigin.Y, hrp.Position.Z), dt * 2)
end

local function lineOfSight(part)

    local character=part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or part.Parent
    if direction.Magnitude<0.001 then return true end
    local exclusions={camera}
